subject: Maths
title: Reflection
subtitle: Transformations · GCSE Maths
learning_objective: I can reflect shapes in mirror lines including the axes and the lines y = x and y = -x.

key_vocab.definition: A reflection flips a shape across a mirror line. Each point and its image are the same distance from the mirror line.

sections.title: Learning Objective
sections.content: I can reflect shapes in mirror lines including the axes and the lines y = x and y = -x.

sections.title: Key Words
sections.content: reflection -- A reflection flips a shape across a mirror line. Each point and its image are the same distance from the mirror line.

sections.title: Method
sections.content:
Each point is the same perpendicular distance from the mirror line as its image, on the opposite side.
(a, b) in y-axis → (-a, b)
Reflecting in the y-axis negates the x-coordinate

Key examples:
  ✓ Reflect (3, 2) in y-axis gives (-3, 2)  (x changes sign)
  ✓ Reflect (3, 2) in x-axis gives (3, -2)  (y changes sign)
  ✓ Reflect (3, 2) in y = x gives (2, 3)  (swap x and y)
  ✗ Reflect (3, 2) in y-axis gives (3, -2)  (that is reflection in x-axis)
  ✗ Reflection changes the size of the shape  (size stays the same)

sections.title: Worked Example
sections.content:
Example 1 – reflection in y-axis
  Reflect (4, 3) in the y-axis.
  Mirror line is x = 0 (y-axis)
  x-coordinate changes sign: 4 becomes -4
  y-coordinate stays the same: 3
  (-4, 3)
  (Reflection in y-axis: (x, y) becomes (-x, y).)

Example 2 – reflection in x-axis
  Reflect (-2, 5) in the x-axis.
  Mirror line is y = 0 (x-axis)
  x-coordinate stays: -2
  y-coordinate changes sign: 5 becomes -5
  (-2, -5)
  (Reflection in x-axis: (x, y) becomes (x, -y).)

sections.title: Reflection in the y-axis
sections.content:
Reflect each point in the y-axis.

(a) (3, 1)
(b) (-2, 4)
(c) (5, -2)
(d) (0, 7)

sections.title: Reflection in the x-axis
sections.content:
Reflect each point in the x-axis.

(a) (2, 5)
(b) (-3, -1)
(c) (4, 0)
(d) (-1, 6)

sections.title: Reflection in y = x and y = -x
sections.content:
Reflect in the given line.

(a) (2, 5) in y = x
(b) (3, -1) in y = x
(c) (4, 2) in y = -x
(d) (-1, 3) in y = -x

sections.title: Reflection in other lines
sections.content:
Reflect in the given mirror line.

(a) (5, 2) in x = 3
(b) (1, 4) in x = 4
(c) (2, 6) in y = 4
(d) (3, 1) in y = 3

sections.title: Mixed reflections
sections.content:
Perform each reflection.

(a) (4, -1) in y-axis
(b) (-3, 2) in x-axis
(c) (6, 1) in x = 4
(d) (2, 7) in y = 5
(e) (5, 3) in y = x

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content:
✓ Reflecting (3, 2) in the y-axis gives (-3, 2)
✗ Reflecting (3, 2) in the y-axis gives (3, -2)
✓ Reflection in y = x swaps the x and y coordinates
✗ Reflection changes the size of the shape
✓ A point on the mirror line maps to itself
